info.title: FaceMatch
info.description: Self-hosted face detection and face matching API: enroll people, then identify them in photos and camera frames. Send images as multipart/form-data. Authenticate with the `X-API-Key` header (or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`).

servers.description: Local server. Change it to yours, e.g. https://face.example.com

Liveness/readiness probe: also checks that the database answers.

**Auth:** none (public).

**Auth:** none (public).

post.description:
Find faces in an image (no identity lookup).

**Auth:** the API key, in the `X-API-Key` header (or `Authorization: Bearer`).

Find faces and identify enrolled people. Does not record anything.

Each recognised face has `match.person_id` (and your `external_id`): use these to act on the
result, for example to mark people present in your own system.

**Auth:** the API key, in the `X-API-Key` header (or `Authorization: Bearer`).

parameters.name: liveness

schema.description: Check recognised faces for a printed photo or a screen held up to the camera; one that fails is returned without its match (unknown_reason liveness_failed). Defaults to the server's LIVENESS setting. Use false for uploaded photos, which aren't re-captured.
schema.title: Liveness

parameters.description: Check recognised faces for a printed photo or a screen held up to the camera; one that fails is returned without its match (unknown_reason liveness_failed). Defaults to the server's LIVENESS setting. Use false for uploaded photos, which aren't re-captured.

schema.description: For testing and tuning: also return the nearest enrolled person for unknown faces.

post.description:
Enroll a person. Only photos are required: the response's `person.id` is returned as
`person_id` in every match, so store it in your system. 3-5 photos (slightly different
angles/lighting) give the best accuracy.

**Auth:** the API key, in the `X-API-Key` header (or `Authorization: Bearer`).

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Optional. Your own fields for this person, as a JSON object of text, numbers, true/false or null (no nested objects or lists). Up to 50 keys of at most 64 characters; text values up to 1000 characters. Returned with the person and with every match, including to kiosks, so don't store secrets here. Send it as JSON text in this form field.

PersonUpdate.title: PersonUpdate
PersonUpdate.description: Only the fields you send are changed.

box.description: Bounding box in original image pixels.

landmarks.title: Landmarks
landmarks.description: Right eye, left eye, nose tip, right mouth corner, left mouth corner.

match.description: Null when the face is unknown.

unknown_reason.title: Unknown Reason
unknown_reason.description: Why match is null: face too small, closest person below MATCH_THRESHOLD, two people too close to call (MATCH_MARGIN), nobody enrolled, or the face looks like a photo or screen (liveness_failed).

closest.description: Only with ?closest=true, for testing and tuning: the nearest enrolled person when match is null. Never set for liveness_failed. Never treat it as a match.

liveness_score.title: Liveness Score
liveness_score.description: Probability that the face is live (not a printed photo or a screen), for recognised faces when the liveness check runs. Null for unknown faces.
